depConstraints.description: The model of one bounded context. It names no contract, no service and no store — only model.
depConstraints.remediation: Move the collaborator into layer:domain, or express the need as an interface the application layer satisfies.

depConstraints.description: Use cases orchestrate the model and speak to other contexts through their published language, never through their model.
depConstraints.remediation: Translate at the boundary: consume the other context's layer:published-language project instead of its layer:domain one.

depConstraints.description: Persistence, messaging and the anti-corruption layer — where another context's shape is allowed to arrive and be translated.
depConstraints.remediation: Nothing inside the model or the use cases may import this layer; invert the dependency with an interface they own.

depConstraints.description: Integration events and contracts are what other contexts are allowed to couple to, so they may couple to nothing else.
depConstraints.remediation: A contract that needs a model type is leaking the model; restate the type in the contract project.

depConstraints.description: Whatever a context keeps to itself is reachable from nothing but itself. Valid only where one project is one bounded context — see the presets page before selecting this profile.
depConstraints.remediation: Publish what the other context needs as a share:published contract, and depend on that.
